title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, of the other part
part_text: 37. Recognises the right of Uzbekistan to ensure the transparency of foreign funding in the interest of national security and to prevent foreign malign influence; recognises the right of Uzbekistan to regulate the financial oversight of NGO activities, aimed at ensuring maximum transparency and accountability, and aligning Uzbekistan’s regulatory framework with international best practice for national security and financial integrity;
